column1: # comment: "GraphRAG pipeline alignments (consumer: Project Lillith). The pipeline activities are prov:Activity by inheritance (provenance set); cells here cover the artifacts. schema.org: the corpus is the working dataset surface (the Croissant profile builds on this cell). Wikidata: hub identifiers for the technique family \u2014 several cells are relatedMatch because Wikidata names the TECHNIQUE (community detection, summarization) where GMEOW names the derived ARTIFACT."

# # REFUSED (Principle 5 — the genuine gap): gmeow:Embedding / gmeow:VectorIndex have no external RDF vocabulary to cell against — model, dimensionality, metric, and index parameters have no agreed semantic representation anywhere. Recorded rather than papered over; revisit when a standard emerges.

# # REFUSED (Principle 5 — no stable RDF namespace): OpenLineage and MLflow describe runs/lineage as JSON specs, not RDF vocabularies; bridging is a projection concern (the Workflow Run Crate), not a term alignment.
# # REFUSED (Principle 5 — instance-level): Leiden/Louvain algorithm identities belong on the clustering Activity as instance data, not as TBox alignments.

# # REFUSED (Principles 5/9 — the description/entity boundary): ExtractedEntity aligns to NOTHING entity-shaped (schema:Thing included): a description is not the thing it describes, and a mapping-layer bridge would invite consumers to skip the curation act that promotes one.
